newsitem.title: MOLDOVA: Moldova cuts its discount rate to 18 pct annual.
newsitem.headline: Moldova cuts its discount rate to 18 pct annual.

text.p: Moldova's National (central) bank has cut its official discount rate to 18 percent annual, the lowest level since the start of market reforms in January 1992, from 22 percent, a bank official said on Thursday.
The new rate was set at a credit auction on Wednesday, where 15 banks bought 45.18 million lei ($9.7 million) offered by the National Bank.

Trailing inflation levels, the official discount rate has been gradually falling from its February 1994 peak of 377 percent. Over this period the National Bank has eliminated soft loans to the economy by selling up to 90 percent of its credit resources at regular auctions.
Officials say 1996 annual inflation will fall to about 16 percent from 23.8 percent in 1995. The 1997 target is a 10-percent inflation.
